item.title: Bengaluru techie earning Rs 1.8 lakh/month faces ICU emergency: 'I was crushing it'
item.summary: A Bengaluru techie's emergency revealed income differs from accessible cash. His savings and investments were unavailable during a critical hospital admission. This incident highlighted the crucial need for liquid emergency funds before aggressive investing. Readers emphasized building emergency reserves and securing adequate health insurance coverage. High earnings alone do not ensure financial security; accessible funds are paramount.
